# Thimble Trail

A cozy quilt puzzle for Android, built with Flutter. Lay fabric patches to
stitch a trail from the spool to the thimble in as few patches as you can.
48 solver-proven blocks in five chapters, an offline Pattern of the Day,
ribbons, and an heirloom quilt that fills up as you play. No ads, no
purchases, no accounts, no data collected, no permissions.

## Run

```bash
flutter pub get
flutter run
```

## Test

```bash
flutter analyze
flutter test
```

`test/levels_test.dart` re-proves every level's par with the solver.

## Content and assets (all generated by scripts in `tool/`)

| Script | Produces |
|--------|----------|
| `dart run tool/generate_levels.dart` | `lib/data/levels.dart` (blocks 3–48; 1–2 hand-made) |
| `python tool/make_art.py` | `assets/images/*` fabrics, wall, tables, spool, thimble, button, logo |
| `python tool/make_sfx.py` | `assets/sfx/*.wav` effects and music-box loop |
| `python tool/make_store_art.py` | `assets/icon/*`, `store/icon-512.png`, `store/feature-graphic.png` |
| `dart run flutter_launcher_icons` | Android launcher icons from `assets/icon/` |

## Layout

```
lib/engine/   pure-Dart rules, solver, level generator (no Flutter imports)
lib/data/     levels and chapters
lib/services/ save data, ribbons, sound + haptics
lib/ui/       palette, type, art loader, glyph icons
lib/widgets/  board painter, heirloom quilt, shared pieces
lib/screens/  splash, hub, play, guide, quiet room, ledger, privacy
```

## Release (signed builds come only from GitHub Actions)

`.github/workflows/android-release.yml` runs on every push (and on demand):
analyze → tests → decode the keystore from secrets → build a **release-signed**
APK and AAB → delete the keystore → upload artifacts
`thimble-trail-release-apk` and `thimble-trail-release-aab`. If the keystore
secret is missing the job fails; it never falls back to debug signing.

### 1. Create the upload keystore (once, on your machine)

```bash
bash scripts/generate_keystore.sh
```

or on Windows PowerShell: `powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/generate_keystore.ps1`.

The script only asks for company details (name, unit, organisation, city,
state, country), an alias, validity and two passwords. It reads nothing from
your system, network or location and fills nothing in automatically. It
writes `scripts/patchwork-upload.jks` and `scripts/patchwork-keystore-base64.txt`
(both gitignored). Back the keystore and passwords up **offline**; losing them
means you can't update the app.

### 2. Add the four repository secrets

```bash
gh secret set PATCHWORK_KEYSTORE_BASE64 < scripts/patchwork-keystore-base64.txt
gh secret set PATCHWORK_STORE_PASSWORD
gh secret set PATCHWORK_KEY_ALIAS
gh secret set PATCHWORK_KEY_PASSWORD
```

(The last three prompt for the value so it never lands in shell history.)

### 3. Trigger a build

Push to any branch, or run **Actions → Android Release Build → Run
workflow**. Download the AAB from the run's artifacts and upload it to Play
Console. Never build the release locally and never commit keystores.

See `docs/` for the design docs, compliance audit and privacy policy.
